environment: Production React build + Chromium + real FastAPI endpoints + disposable SQLite. Synthetic accounts only; no payment/shipment provider calls.

results.name: Unauthenticated Meowsurement uses website login and incomplete customer profile; no PIN or local accounts
Incomplete prescription is a draft; literal zero survives; nonzero CYL requires AXIS

Product detail reflects effective variant geometry and carries frame selection into Meowsurement

Preparation, three independent manual PD readings, submission and evidence-bound approval use existing website accounts
Concurrent profile update shows conflict and cannot overwrite saved version or old session snapshot
Existing admin review queue opens customer session without requiring an admin prescription profile
Profile and admin specification editor fit a 390px viewport; customer cannot access catalog admin
